determinism.note: 5 cold runs produced 5 DIFFERENT per-run report hashes and exactly ONE tokenwise-KL tensor hash. The report hashes embed run index, paths and timings; the tensor hash is the evidence.

disclosures.detail: The Dione checkpoint ships no upstream receipts, reconstruction closures or sealed reader ABI. The packed surface was decoded WITHOUT seal verification; the immutable repo revision and the consumed payload sha256s were recorded instead, and every whole shard was verified against the release's own exl3-manifest.json (shard_hash_verification: full).
